systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.country_label: SIPAO (WAPIS); future centre de recueil et d'enregistrement des données (DACORE)
systems.owner: INTERPOL programme, funded by the European Union (11th EDF); Liberia signed the memorandum of understanding with INTERPOL, among the first to do so
systems.tiers: Liberia joined in November 2017. A first lot of equipment (workstations, scanners, servers) was handed over in Liberia on 5 July 2019 to begin digitising police data held on paper; premises for the future national centre were found and being rehabilitated, with inauguration possible at the end of 2019; first training given in August or early September 2019. No centre operating and no station named.

note: No fact: for Liberia the newsletter reports a donation of equipment and a centre not yet opened, to digitise existing paper police data; it does not say that any station enters reports or cases in the system, so it is unclassified. French edition of the same issue as document 62.
